SELECT pr.id, pr.reporter_id, pr.reason, pr.status, pr.created_at
FROM post_reports pr
WHERE pr.post_id = #{postId}
ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC, pr.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_reports pr WHERE pr.post_id = #{postId} AND pr.status = 'PENDING'

SELECT p.id, p.member_id, pc.name AS category_name, p.title, p.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_reports pr WHERE pr.post_id = p.id AND pr.status = 'PENDING') AS pending_report_count, p.created_at
FROM posts p JOIN post_categories pc ON pc.id = p.category_id
ORDER BY pending_report_count DESC, p.id DESC
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE posts p SET p.status = 'BLOCKED', p.blocked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), p.blocked_reason = #{reason}, p.blocked_by = #{adminId}, p.updated_at = p.updated_at WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED'
UPDATE posts p SET p.status = 'PUBLISHED', p.updated_at = p.updated_at WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.status = 'BLOCKED'
